experiments.scope: Exact 32-round SHA-256 of seed-derived 55-byte messages. 512 messages per trial, pair agreeing on the top 18 digest bits.
experiments.hypothesis: The top 18 digest bits behave like a uniform slice, so a trial finds a pair with probability about 0.393.

experiments.scope: Same construction. Pair agreeing on the top 6 bits of each of digest words H0, H1 and H3.
experiments.hypothesis: An 18 bit slice spread over three digest words in the slot region behaves like a uniform slice.
